course_modules.title: macOS Dock Physics & Magnification Curves
course_modules.text: Engineer the physics-based macOS dock where icon scales and translations dynamically curve based on Gaussian distance from the user cursor.
course_modules.voice_script: Welcome to the macOS Desktop architecture module. In step one, we construct the parabolic magnification dock using Gaussian distance formulas.

quiz.question: Which mathematical function produces the smoothest parabolic scaling for macOS dock icons?
options: Cosine squared decay based on normalized mouse distance
Linear subtraction with hard boundary clamping
quiz.explanation: Cosine squared falloff (Math.cos(distance/radius * PI/2)^2) yields smooth acceleration and deceleration without sharp inflection points.

course_modules.title: Window Manager & Draggable Panes
course_modules.text: Implement the desktop window stack manager with z-index elevation on focus, smooth window dragging with velocity dampening, and traffic light controls (close, minimize, maximize).
course_modules.voice_script: In step two, we engineer the window orchestration engine, handling coordinate transforms, active focus hierarchies, and macOS traffic lights.

quiz.question: How does the window manager ensure the clicked window always stays on top?
options: By maintaining an incremental z-index counter and setting it on the active window on mousedown
By deleting all background window DOM elements
By placing all windows inside separate HTML iframes
quiz.explanation: Incrementing a shared z-index counter on each focus event ensures the most recently interacted window floats above all others.

course_modules.title: Glassmorphism & Backdrop Filters
course_modules.text: Craft the frosted Apple glass aesthetic using backdrop-filter blur, specular edge highlight borders, and dynamic noise grain textures.
course_modules.voice_script: Step three focuses on visual design: the frosted glassmorphism menu bar, subtle translucent cards, and high-DPI retina border rings.

quiz.question: Why is saturate(180%) coupled with blur() in authentic Apple glassmorphism?
options: To compensate for luminance loss through heavy diffusion and keep underlying wallpaper colors vibrant
To invert colors on high-contrast monitors
quiz.explanation: Heavy gaussian blurring washes out color vibrancy; adding saturate(180%) restores the rich pop of the underlying wallpaper.

course_modules.title: Spotlight Search & Command Palette
course_modules.text: Construct the Cmd+Space global spotlight search bar with fuzzy app filtering, quick calculator evaluation, and keyboard navigation.
course_modules.voice_script: Step four integrates Spotlight Search. We build a reactive fuzzy-search engine that queries apps, files, and commands with keyboard shortcuts.

quiz.question: Which keyboard shortcut natively invokes Spotlight search on macOS?
quiz.explanation: Command + Space is the iconic macOS system shortcut for launching the global Spotlight search bar.

course_modules.title: Dynamic Wallpapers & Theme Sync
course_modules.text: Wire up the Control Center theme engine supporting Sonoma, Sequoia, and Ventura dynamic wallpapers with system dark/light mode synchronization.
course_modules.voice_script: Finally, in step five, we assemble the System Settings and Control Center, enabling real-time wallpaper shifts and brightness dimming.

quiz.question: What web storage mechanism allows the user's custom wallpaper choice to persist across browser sessions?
quiz.explanation: localStorage persists key-value data indefinitely across browser reloads without requiring server round-trips.

course_modules.title: Multi-Window Desktop OS Architecture
course_modules.text: Build the full React window management system supporting z-index layering, minimize, maximize, and smooth drag mechanics.
course_modules.voice_script: Welcome to the macOS OS architecture course. In step one, we construct the multi-window desktop coordinate matrix.
course_modules.code_snippet: const bringToFront = (id) => setWindows(prev => prev.map(w => w.id === id ? { ...w, zIndex: Math.max(...prev.map(x => x.zIndex)) + 1 } : w));

quiz.question: How does macOS manage active window focus layering in DOM?
options: By incrementing the active window's zIndex above all sibling windows
By converting the window to SVG
quiz.explanation: Dynamic zIndex stacking simulates true desktop OS window hierarchies seamlessly.
